request.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Create ONE edge-to-edge landscape PNG at exactly 1536×1024. Location-key establish recipe: full environment detail and a clearly readable named light source; no collage, border or panels.

L12 rooftop_room/stairs_night.png: THE OUTDOOR STAIR LANDING UP TO THE APPROVED ROOFTOP ROOM AT NIGHT, UNDER A BARE BULB. An empty location reference before the characters arrive. Camera at ordinary adult eye height from the last few outdoor concrete steps looking slightly upward onto their top landing and across toward the familiar rooftop-room door. Give the top step and landing space where people can later stand, with the stair rail cropped naturally in the lower-left foreground. These are normal stairs, with roughly 18 cm risers and a supported handrail about 1.1 m above the treads, leading directly to the green waterproofed rooftop floor. The stairwell mouth is the opening near the foreground edge in the approved wide key, seen now from within its final short flight. A simple warm-white BARE BULB in a socket on a visible short lead is mounted above this stair landing; it is the local key light. Keep the approved room facade and its separate caged wall fixture unchanged in the middle distance. Do not turn the caged fixture into the bare stair bulb: the new bare bulb illuminates the previously off-camera stair opening.

Match the approved rooftop location geometry and materials: old beige-grey peeling plaster, green waterproofing #4E8F5A, the dark grey steel room door hinged on picture-left, the small dark-framed window to the right of that door, shallow corrugated grey roof, cylindrical steel water tank beyond the window. The open room door spills a little warm household light onto the rooftop floor; a small glimpse of the fold-out table and warm room is enough, respecting the attached interior layout. Keep the approximately 2.1 m room doorway and normal step dimensions on one coherent ground plane and perspective, without compressing them to make everything fit. Crop the near rails and farther roof as necessary. The stair flight is concrete with attached, supported metal railings; no floating steps, posts in the walking route, or railings crossing through the doorway. Landing, last steps and room door are the focus. Laundry lines, plastic chairs and water tank can sit naturally farther across the roof where the view permits; do not drag all props into the landing. Beyond the low parapet, restrained cool blue-night Mapo buildings and distant Han River bridge lights, secondary in contrast and detail. Night palette: navy shadows #1B2440, warm household/stair-bulb light #F0B064, green roof floor. The local bulb and door spill explain the warm patches; cool city fill stays subdued. Clear crisp ink and large opaque cel-value planes, restrained worn-plaster details. No people, silhouettes, animals, text, glyphs, signs, numbers, logos, UI or screens. No fog, cinematic blur or glossy CG concrete.

The first three attachments are APPROVED Arc 1 rooftop-room night/day/interior keys: preserve their architectural identity, palette, material language and consistent spatial relationships while drawing the new stair-landing angle. The final attachment is an APPROVED acting-style anchor for crisp tapered black ink, opaque cel shadow shapes and controlled source light only; do not copy its character or dungeon setting. No unapproved generated art or reject is an input.



No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.

attempt_cap: Initial plus up to three redos; one initial used, no redos needed for an observed failure.
reference_policy: Three inspected approved Arc 1 rooftop-room keys plus one approved acting-style anchor. No generated candidate, reject, retired or unapproved image used.

checks.required_content: Outdoor last steps and green rooftop landing, bare bulb overhead at the stair opening, approved rooftop-room doorway beyond; no people or text.
checks.light_observation: Visible warm bare bulb at upper-left stair landing, separate approved caged door light and open-room spill, cool navy city fill. Local warm pools read at 200 px; no reserved magical glow.
checks.continuity_observation: Approved peeling plaster, left-hinged dark door, small window right of door, corrugated roof, steel tank, laundry and night skyline retained. Approved caged facade fixture remains separate from the new bare stair bulb. Interior glimpse contains fold-out table and warm lamp.
checks.perspective_observation: Concrete treads meet landing; rail posts have attachment plates, floor and roof doorway share a coherent perspective by visual inspection. No measured calibration or scale figure in this empty extra view.
checks.style_quality_observation: Inspected original at native resolution, 200 px overview and 200% stair/door details. Ink and cel value masses remain clear; no visible glyphs, detached fixtures, block compression, edge ringing or smeared colour found in those inspections.
caveats: The stair enclosure, overhead slab and new bare-bulb position extend an off-camera area of the approved keys. Claude must confirm their spatial relationship to the canonical rooftop stair opening.
The 18 cm step, 1.1 m rail and 2.1 m doorway are prompted nominal anchors, not pixel-measured dimensions.
No people are drawn in this extra view; future panel staging must check character scale.
not_applicable: Acting and character side locks: empty location extra view
Tiny scale people: required for key.png, not this extra-view file
Flat grey sheet backdrop: this is a full environment key
